purpose: Exact privileged Edge Function set intentionally deferred until source caller semantics are preserved or final cutover makes the independent target authoritative.

policy.pre_cutover: Do not weaken authorization and do not add a new handler guard on main when an unobservable Lovable/platform caller could be broken.
policy.cutover: Every entry must receive an explicit caller trust boundary before Lovable-pause readiness can pass.
policy.forbidden_shortcut: A Supabase anon/publishable key or gateway verify_jwt alone is not privileged authorization.

functions.name: autonomous-accumulator
functions.evidence: Repository comments/migrations describe scheduled accumulation, but no conclusive direct Edge Function HTTP scheduler was found. Historical database-side accumulation scheduling exists.
functions.cutover_requirement: Inventory restored/live scheduler state, replace any source/runtime caller with target invoke_aicis_edge_function + x-cron-secret, then add requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.
